definitions.full: H4787. morrah [ מָרָּה ] noun feminine bitterness (on form see Ges § 22 , 5 R); — construct נַפְשׁוֺ מָרַּת יוֺדֵעַ לֵב Prov 14:10 the heart knoweth the bitterness of its soul (its own misery).
